title: Engineering at AI Speed
author: Kurt Mitchell
description: Implementation became cheap before alignment did. A series about the engineering discipline that makes AI speed useful.

episodes.title: Implementation Is Cheap. Alignment Isn’t.
episodes.description: The premise of the series: implementation accelerated. Shared understanding still takes work.

episodes.title: When Words Become Code
episodes.description: A product catalog, a product registry, and the architecture hiding inside a name.

episodes.title: Building a World Around a Terrible API
episodes.description: Catalogs, worlds, snapshots, and the vocabulary of an integration environment you can trust.

episodes.title: The Friction We Lost
episodes.description: Some development friction was carrying information. Preserve its useful functions.

episodes.title: “Implement This” Is Not a Requirement
episodes.description: Turn an outcome into scope, constraints, failure behavior, and acceptance criteria.

episodes.title: Two Correct Implementations of Two Different Ideas
episodes.description: How reasonable interpretations collide at the integration boundary.

episodes.title: When Everyone Can Implement, Who Owns the Architecture?
episodes.description: Decision rights and shared responsibility when more people can change the system.

episodes.title: Architecture Has to Become Executable
episodes.description: Make decisions visible in contracts, invariants, tests, and agent instructions.

episodes.title: Review Starts Before Generation
episodes.description: Specify, constrain, generate in bounded increments, and verify the evidence.
